title: Frank T Probable NDE 4605
content: I was involved in a motorcycle accident. I had a lacerated liver and internal bleeding. While in hospital, I lost consciousness and was brought to operating room. I underwent ten hours of surgery and received twenty-two pints of blood. At several times during the surgery, I was aware of events that were occurring in the operating room. I was also aware of the presence of my deceased grandmother, which gave me a strange sense of peace.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident. Surgery-related 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death'
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Void | Darkness | Boundary
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Less consciousness and alertness than normal I don't understand the question.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time was suspended and unfolded like fade-in scenes in a movie.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes Met my grandmother. She indicated (without speaking) she was there to take me somewhere.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin

elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Shared with family immediately afterward. Shared with friends sometime later. Family's reaction was comforting and relieved.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was probably real Time has dulled the emotional intensity, but not the details of the events.
